dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concave curvature of the trailing edge, exhibiting a smooth spline transition from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a medium pixel radius; non-acute highest point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Anterior margin demonstrates a steep angular inclination of approximately 55 degrees relative to the primary horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.4:1 ratio of the maximum longitudinal base width to the maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex, semi-circular melon boundary with a consistent radius that tapers toward the anterior point.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Visible rostrum characterized by a short longitudinal pixel length and a robust, thick vertical profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct concave inflection point at the pixel junction where the descending melon slope meets the horizontal plane of the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint linear longitudinal striations along the lateral flank; light-pigmented focal patch on the mid-leading edge of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast cyan tonal gradient with localized specular highlights on the dorsal ridge and mid-lateral body segment.
